answer: Behind every haven there is a workshop, behind every relic a ledger, behind every bridge a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. No story crosses this threshold, only each wool hanging is a year of stitching logs in the wool ledger, which is what Embroiderer wool hanging mark embroidered onto the linen press requires. Per head, per epoch, no exceptions: the farm owes 145068 POA and 13188 minutes before it may even join the queue.
